topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture on the complement system and acknowledges the complexity of its nomenclature.

topics.label: Fundamentals and Central Role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: They provide an overview of complement biology, explain the system's naming conventions, and establish C3 cleavage as the central event of the cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of Complement Activation
topics.groupedBecause: They explain the three upstream pathways that detect pathogens and generate convertases to trigger complement activation.

topics.label: Complement Effector Functions
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the downstream mechanisms through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and stimulates inflammation.

topics.label: Host Regulation and Protection
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the regulatory mechanisms host cells deploy to prevent complement activation and avoid self-damage.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It details the distinct clinical presentations and disease susceptibilities resulting from deficiencies in individual complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion Strategies
topics.groupedBecause: It illustrates the molecular mechanisms pathogens utilize to circumvent complement-mediated immune destruction.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the subsequent lecture topic.
